LanguageData.LP_Tadpole.label: mind flayer tadpole
LanguageData.LP_Tadpole.description: A slimy little purple tadpole that keeps wriggling in its jar. Placed into a humanlike's skull through surgery, it burrows into the brain and remakes the host into a new mind flayer within a few days (ceremorphosis). The resulting mind flayer joins the implanter's faction.\n\nA fire giant's molten body scalds the tadpole to death; liches, necromantic constructs and mechanoids have no living brain; troll regeneration slows and expels it; the brain of the psychically deaf starves it; mind resistance slows the ceremorphosis. A tadpole outside a host survives no more than 15 days.
